newsitem.title: USA: BOK Financial, Park Cities to merge.
newsitem.headline: BOK Financial, Park Cities to merge.

text.p: BOK Financial Corp said it reached a preliminary agreement to purchase First National Bank of Park Cities in Dallas.
The merger agreement, calling for a cash and installment sale transaction, was reached with Park Cities Bancshares Inc, parent of First National Bank of Park Cities.
The transaction is subject to a definitive agreement, approval by the Park Cities board and shareholders, and regulatory approval.

"For several years, we have had a strategic objective of entering the high-growth Dallas and north Texas market," Stanley Lybarger, president of BOK Financial, said in a statement issued September 15.
He added that BOK has a significant portfolio of oil and gas loans in the Dallas area.
Park Cities has $220 million in assets. BOK Financial, a two-bank holding company, has $4.4 billion in assets.
